remarks: Opportunity Knocks in Plum Tree Condos - Bring Your Vision! Welcome to Plum Tree Condominiums, where this spacious unit offers a fantastic opportunity for buyers ready to roll up their sleeves and add their personal touch. With great bones and a smart layout, this condo is full of potential and just waiting for the right updates to shine. Featuring comfortable living space, ample natural light, and generously sized rooms, the unit provides a solid foundation for renovation. Whether you're looking to customize your first home, downsize with style, or invest in a promising property, this is the perfect canvas. Enjoy all the perks of the Plum Tree community, including well-maintained grounds, assigned parking, and a convenient location close to shops, restaurants, and commuter routes. With a little TLC, this hidden gem can truly sparkle. Don't miss your chance to make it your own-schedule a showing today and imagine the possibilities!
